'''Maqi''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}} and the receptionist for the [[Pioneer Association]] [[Jinzhou]] branch. 

Players can speak to her to view their [[Pioneer Association/Exploration Progress|Exploration Progress]] and claim rewards.

==Dialogue== 
{{Dialogue start}}
:'''Maqi:''' Here is to a world of discoveries and wonder! Hello! Welcome to the Pioneer Association's Jinzhou branch.
:{{DIcon}}About my Exploration Progress.
::'''Maqi:''' Thank you. Please wait while the system is establishing the connection to your terminal.
::(Opens Huanglong Exploration Progress.)
:{{DIcon}}About the Pioneer Association.
::'''Maqi:''' The Pioneer Association, originally known as the Universal Geographic Society, believes in the core values of exploring and understanding the world.
::'''Maqi:''' As we reconstruct the civilization to its former prosperity, the Pioneer Association brings back from the field signs that proves the world is getting better.
::'''Maqi:''' Witness the future that humanity is heading into with geographic documentation.
:{{DIcon}} About yourself.
::'''Maqi:''' Me? I am the receptionist at the Jinzhou branch, responsible for receiving Pioneer members in the Jinzhou area and recruiting more members.
::'''Maqi:''' By the way, the pre-sale of the new merch of the Ploneer Association has started. You can place orders now if you find anything you like.
::'''Maqi:''' May the world unfold before your eyes, looking forward to seeing you next time.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave.
{{Dialogue end}}
